name: Avatar
summary: Represents a user or entity with image or initials.

a11y.apg: No APG pattern: an avatar is an image. Decorative next to the name it repeats — pass alt="" then, which is the default, so it does not read the same name twice. When the avatar is the only identification, alt carries the name.

props.name: src
props.description: The picture. A broken URL falls back instead of showing the browser's broken-image glyph — measured, it did not before.

props.name: alt
props.description: Empty by default, because an avatar usually sits beside the name it stands for and repeating it is noise. Fill it when the avatar is the only identification.

props.name: fallback
props.description: What shows with no src, or when src fails: initials, an icon, anything. Without it the circle is empty, which is a legitimate placeholder.

props.name: size
props.description: Token scale, not pixels. It shares --control-h-* with the controls, so an avatar next to a button of the same size lines up by construction, and density reaches it.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the outermost element, after the Aurea skin — your class wins on a tie.
